title: CARTA global jurisdiction classification crosswalk
methodology: ISO alpha-2 codes are identifiers for country or area records; an ISO code is not evidence of sovereignty or UN membership.
UN M49 is used for geographic continent and sub-region assignments. The UN explicitly says these groupings are for statistical convenience and do not imply political affiliation or legal status.
UN membership is separately classified from the current UN membership list. Exactly 193 records are marked sovereign_state and is_un_member=true.
Holy See (VA) and State of Palestine (PS) are non-member observer states; they are represented as sovereign_state with is_un_member=false.

All other non-member country/area records remain jurisdiction_kind=unclassified until their precise constitutional and territorial status is reviewed. This deliberately avoids inferring sovereignty or dependency from ISO/M49 inclusion.
Kosovo (XK) and Taiwan (TW) use manual geographic placements because they are not present as separate entries in the UN M49 table used here. These placements make no political-status determination.
Western Sahara (EH), Cook Islands (CK) and Niue (NU) are flagged for special-status review; geographic placement does not settle their legal or political status.
This is directory metadata only. It does not verify a constitution, legal publisher, currentness, licence, or permission to display, index, summarise, translate or cache legal texts.
